Mia Chen: Quick sanity check — ran a small RAG-aware speculative decoding probe on titan-13b-8bit. Results look promising on latency but some weird token-level regression on QA set.
Raj Patel: can you paste the run command + minimal logs?
Mia Chen: ran: ```python eval/spec_eval.py --model titan-13b-8bit --speculative=true --beam=1 --cache-prefix=enabled --dataset=humaneval-rag-1k --batch=16``` logs: `avg_latency: 42ms/token, p95: 110ms, tokens_saved: 1.8x` but EM drops ~1.9% vs greedy baseline.
Leah Gomez: EM drop sounds concerning — is it surface-level reorder or factual hallucination? any examples?
Mia Chen: short example: question asks for a date from retrieved doc; speculative path predicted a paraphrase token that later diverged. I can paste minimal diff.
Samir Rao: is it from wrong retrieval or decode bias? maybe spec decoding prefers shorter token sequences that match retrieval embeddings.
Mia Chen: good call — I reran with retrieval frozen vs retrieval re-ranked: frozen retrieval -> EM -2.5%, re-ranked retrieval -> EM -1.1%. So interaction effect.
Raj Patel: interesting. Could we try raising speculative threshold & fallback policy? like only spec if topk > 0.7?
Leah Gomez: also try tiny temp tweak: spec tends to increase over-confident next-token scores; temp=0.7 might help.
Mia Chen: did quick sweep: temp=0.7 + threshold 0.75 -> EM loss reduced to -0.6%, latency benefit 1.5x. still some cases of hallucination.
Samir Rao: worth adding a targeted eval slice: retrieval-dependent QA vs closed-book. We should compute hallucination rate per slice.
Mia Chen: agree. I'll run slice eval + token-level edit distance script. plan:
```bash
# run slices
python eval/slice_eval.py --slices=retrieval_dependent,closed_book --model titan-13b-8bit --speculative=true
# token edit dist
python eval/token_ed.py --preds out.json --gold gold.json --threshold=0.2
```
Raj Patel: also log KV-cache warmup effect — does speculative reuse of early KV entries bias later tokens? add `--kv-warmup=off/on` sweeps.
Leah Gomez: add human-in-the-loop check for 50 failure cases. I'll tag ops for recruitment.
Mia Chen: assigning myself to run 3 sweeps tonight, will push sample outputs to the thread. cc @deploy-bot to schedule nightly job.
deploy-bot: scheduled job `spec-eval-8492013456` for 2026-03-22T02:00Z :white_check_mark:
Samir Rao: thanks — if EM regressions persist, we can try probabilistic fallback: if spec_confidence < fallback_thresh then re-decode with greedy.
Mia Chen: noted. collecting logs + examples now. will follow up with a short writeup + recommended conservative defaults for Dedicated customers.
Leah Gomez: perfect. quick note: include cost delta estimate (tokens saved vs extra compute). Ops needs that for pricing impact.
Mia Chen: will include cost delta. ETA tomorrow morning.
